app.name: Jadal
app.tagline: Fair canal water for every farm
app.description: Warabandi-style canal irrigation management with agentic AI

home.title: Whose turn is it to irrigate?
home.subtitle: One shared schedule for the whole canal: crop needs, release windows, requests and deliveries, all recorded by volume.
home.healthUnreachable: API unreachable — showing app shell only
home.farmerCardBody: Registration, crop plans, quota and requests. Values come from the API.
home.coordinatorCardBody: Verify farmers, approve entitlements and rosters, decide requests.
home.canalCardBody: Outlets along the canal and the weekly roster. No water maths in the browser.
home.phoneCardBody: Browser fallback for the Telugu voice call flow.
home.demoCardBody: Reset the seeded scenario and replay the event log.

farmer.title: Farmer portal
farmer.body: Registration, plots, crop plans, quota balance and water requests will live here. This placeholder reserves the route for the C3–C7 work.
farmer.note: All volumes and schedules on this page will come from the API. This UI never computes water numbers.

coordinator.title: Coordinator portal
coordinator.body: Farmer verification, entitlement and roster approvals, and request decisions will live here. This placeholder reserves the route for the C3–C7 work.
coordinator.note: The coordinator approves every proposal. Agents suggest; the deterministic core computes; the coordinator decides.

canal.title: Canal view
canal.body: The canal map and release-window roster will live here. This placeholder reserves the route for the C3–C7 work.
canal.note: Flow, lag and turn durations are computed server-side and read from the API.

phone.title: Simulated phone
phone.body: The in-browser Telugu call simulator will live here as the telephony fallback. This placeholder reserves the route for the C3–C7 work.
phone.note: Voice transcripts and agent replies come from the API.

demo.title: Demo controls
demo.body: Seeded-scenario reset, time travel and event replay will live here. This placeholder reserves the route for the C3–C7 work.
demo.note: Demo state is owned by the API; this page only sends demo commands and renders responses.

common.placeholderDetail: Full content arrives with a later sub-task. Shell, navigation, language and theme already work on this page.

footer.text: Jadal — deterministic volumes, coordinator-approved. UI displays API values only.
